"It is unknown to me that anyone of L's family was expelled by the Communist Party.

's secretary, I met him sometimes; more regularly while at Berlin, and even occasionally in London, the last time in April 1940.

Walter L. was frequently writing in the Berlin paper "Rote Fahne", the daily of the Communist Party since about 1920 up to the suppression of that paper. He played a big part in the Communist Organization of Germany and used to pull the strings between the Party in Berlin and the Party in Moscow. Most interested in Economy, he wrote many of the speeches for the Communist M.P.'s given at Reichstag meetings, he certainly supplied all the material requested by Moscow as long as this was possible from Berlin.

The foundation of the "Neu Beginnen" was up to to-day unknown to me as well as his book with the same heading.

The question "Has L. supplied military figures to the USSR"? cannot be answered straight forward by me. Definitely he has supplied the USSR with such figures while in Germany and definitely he has supplied the USSR with all figures available to him while in this country; so the question whether he sent on military data from here remains open as it is not known to me whether any figures were available to him at all.

I last met him in April 1940 at which occasion he told me that all Germans have, according to reliable information received by him, to reckon to be interned within the next few weeks. More details about future actions by English authorities were told to me at that occasion and since that day I was really afraid to meet him again.

(The reason being that gained the impression that L. is receiving informations the character of which are obviously to be kept secret).
